_note: Read only by src/support.mjs, which makes the support export from it and the site (published by the real build at /support.json, a different file from this one, which Toran reads once a day; and written by npm run support), for Toran answering OpenFrequency's own support. Where the site describes the product ahead of what it does, these say what is true today: "today" (a list of sentences) replaces toran.today for the agent, and "answers" ([{q, a}]) replaces the site's answer to each FAQ question with exactly that text; {demo.time} and the like are site.config.json facts. Delete an entry once the site and the product agree. Since 2026-11-12 there is none: Toran is on sale and answers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, email and the store's site chat, as the site says, so the export takes toran.today from site.config.json and every answer from /faq.
